rate_status: initial pilot design; verify coverage using local deformation rates, not blade speed alone
reference_crack_area: one projected material crack plane B0*da0; Gc already includes creation of the two faces

test_groups.measurement: mass and reference volume; density including uncertainty

test_groups.design: 3 rates x 5 fresh specimens; DIC and thickness, complete history through failure
3 stretch levels x 3 fresh specimens; pilot levels 1.1/1.3/1.6, subject to prior nondamaging range; bounded dwell <=600 s with recorded plateau/censoring
3 rates x 5 fresh specimens; identical grip geometry and loading history to notched pure-shear tests
3 rates x 5 fresh specimens; measure both loads and local deformation gradients
normal prestrain 0/0.05/0.15 x 3 shear rates x 5 fresh specimens; actual pressure measured; no assumed pressure from strain
3 rates x 5 specimens; initial H0=10 mm, L0>=100 mm, a0=30 mm; actual same-batch thickness measured
a0=20/40 mm x 5 specimens at middle rate; reference H0=10 mm
H0=20 mm, L0>=200 mm, a0=60 mm, same thickness, middle rate; check finite-size and 3D correction
3 measured notch radii, pilot targets 0.05/0.2/1 mm x 5; keep out of strength/Gc fit
3 mixed opening/shear loading ratios x 5; assess shared-Gc hypothesis with independently identified bulk dissipation

additional_identification: Confined/compressibility test or independent lateral DIC with adequate volume-strain resolution; lateral strain indistinguishable from incompressibility gives only a K lower bound
Uniformity-verified multiaxial test if a hydrostatic-strength parameter remains unidentified; bonded poker-chip failure requires inverse field analysis and is not a direct uniform-strength value
Independent blade/rubber sliding tests at >=3 normal loads and 3 sliding speeds, dry/lubricated conditions separately; blade radius/thickness measured before and after
Cyclic/Mullins pilot: if significant, augment bulk law or enforce the same independently documented preconditioning in characterization and cutting

Broadband DMA/high-rate relaxation pilot with instrument bandwidth and temperature recorded; establish whether the millisecond fracture transient is covered before adding fast viscous branches. No specimen count allocated yet; excluded from the 233 enumerated specimens and never inferred from cutting force or numerical energy loss.

groups.design: 3 opening rates x 3 unloading stages x 3 fresh specimens; stages selected from a separate pilot opening test, never from cutting force
groups.measure: synchronized force, local opening, crack reference length, temperature and complete unload/reload path
groups.discriminates: secant versus constant-traction unloading, softening shape, rate dependence; distinguish recoverable work and irreversible crack work

groups.design: 3 normal pressures x 3 sliding speeds x 3 fresh contact patches; pilot speeds 0.02/0.2/2 mm/s; same blade surface and same rubber batch; dry and lubricated conditions require separate designs
groups.measure: normal and tangential loads, actual contact area, local slip, dwell, temperature, surface condition and wear before/after
groups.discriminates: mu pressure slope versus pressure-independent tau_w intercept; uncertainty and low-pressure contact loss must be included

groups.design: 3 geometrically scaled uncracked/notched tensile specimens x 5; preserve a separately measured notch family; original notch-radius holdouts stay excluded from fitting
groups.measure: full-field strain and crack-onset interval at independently measured bulk/strength/Gc
groups.discriminates: whether a finite nonlocal length is identifiable across sizes; report only bounds if not identifiable

execution_stages.note: Subset of the 164, not extra specimens; middle rate, 3 compressed-shear prestrains x 3 specimens. Feasibility/model-discrimination only, not final statistical qualification.
Complete all test groups if pilot supports proceeding; record design amendments before viewing cutting holdouts.
